name: TransparentUpgradeableProxy

match.coverage: Review of the changes to this file introduced by pull request #4224 addressing audit findings.

lines.text: * @dev Modifier used internally that will delegate the call to the implementation unless the sender is the admin.
* CAUTION: This modifier is deprecated, as it could cause issues if the modified function has arguments, and the
* implementation provides a function with the same selector.
* @dev If caller is the admin process the call internally, otherwise transparently fallback to the proxy behavior
revert("TransparentUpgradeableProxy: admin cannot fallback to proxy target");
* NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-getProxyAdmin}.
* TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the
function admin() external ifAdmin returns (address admin_) {
* NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-getProxyImplementation}.
* TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the
function implementation() external ifAdmin returns (address implementation_) {
* @dev Changes the admin of the proxy.
* NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-changeProxyAdmin}.
function changeAdmin(address newAdmin) external virtual ifAdmin {
* @dev Upgrade the implementation of the proxy.
* NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-upgrade}.
* @dev Upgrade the implementation of the proxy, and then call a function from the new implementation as specified
* by `data`, which should be an encoded function call. This is useful to initialize new storage variables in the
* NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. See {ProxyAdmin-upgradeAndCall}.
(address newImplementation, bytes memory data) = abi.decode(msg.data[4:], (address, bytes));
function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data) external payable ifAdmin {
* CAUTION: This function is deprecated. Use {ERC1967Upgrade-_getAdmin} instead.
* @dev To keep this contract fully transparent, all `ifAdmin` functions must be payable. This helper is here to
* emulate some proxy functions being non-payable while still allowing value to pass through.
* @dev Makes sure the admin cannot access the fallback function. See {Proxy-_beforeFallback}.
require(msg.sender != _getAdmin(), "TransparentUpgradeableProxy: admin cannot fallback to proxy target");
